verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm docs confirm vLLM and llama.cpp support plus PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX/ONNX on RDNA GPUs including the 9000 series, giving a real serving-stack story. However, there is no mention of FP8/FP4 low-precision inference support, no TensorRT-LLM support (that's an NVIDIA-specific stack), and no independent/hands-on benchmarks confirming real-world inference performance on this exact card. missing for 10: FP8/FP4 precision documentation, TensorRT-LLM support or explicit non-support clarification, independent hands-on inference benchmarks.
